fact: The DGSN's bilan for 2024 states that its own technical teams integrated into GESTARR a system managing crime and misdemeanour cases at arrondissement level with digitised procedures, following a case from the data GESTARR supplies through investigation to its submission to the judicial authorities, and that it was in use in the préfectures de police of Kénitra, Tanger, Settat, Marrakech and Meknès, the Sûretés régionales of Ouarzazate, Errachidia, Taza and El Hoceima and the Sûretés provinciales of Salé, Safi and El Jadida, ahead of national generalisation.
title: La Direction Générale de la Sûreté Nationale présente son bilan annuel au titre de l’année 2024
